model: YS / YS HP / YN Screw Chiller (SC-EQ)
equipment_type: Water-cooled screw chiller / heat pump (via SC-EQ card)
applies_to: YORK YS and YN water-cooled screw chillers and YS HP heat pumps with OptiView controls, fitted with the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: YS, YS HP and YN screw chillers reach a BAS through the SC-EQ communication card on BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU / N2). The BAS can run/stop the unit and write the leaving chilled liquid setpoint, motor current limit, leaving hot water setpoint and operating mode. Read-only points cover water temperatures, refrigerant and oil pressures, slide valve position, solid-state starter values, and multistate operation, safety, cycling and warning codes.
notes: Access is inferred: the sheet has no read/write column. The remote block (AV 1-4, BV 1) is treated as commandable and MV 65001 as writable; everything else as read-only.
The hot water setpoint (AV 3), operational mode (AV 4) and active leaving heated liquid setpoint (AV 39) apply to YS HP heat pump units.
Starter values (AV 13-18, AV 49-52) only report with a solid-state starter (SSS). kWh = offset x 10,000 + low.

Status-code MVs (MV 1-4) are the printed code + 1, as the doc's status code tables say. MV 5 and MV 65001 are shown as printed, from 0; BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the card may report the printed number + 1. Confirm by discovery. AV 4 is an analog value and takes the printed mode number (0-2).
Units shown are the IP units; with MV 65001 set to SI the card reports °C, kPa and so on.
Spare objects and empty rows are left out.

source.title: YS, YS HP, YN SC-EQ BAS Points List

integration.summary: Wire the BAS to the SC-EQ J12 RS-485 port and set the MAC address; the card detects BACnet MS/TP. Start/stop the unit with BV 1 and write the leaving chilled liquid setpoint (AV 1) and motor current limit (AV 2); on YS HP units also the hot water setpoint (AV 3) and mode (AV 4). Read MV 1, BV 5, the leaving water temperature and % FLA, and MV 2/MV 3 for shutdowns.

minimum_points.name: UNIT CONTROL SOURCE
minimum_points.why: Control source; ISN (BAS) for BMS control

integration.enable: BV 1 REM START STOP CMD (0 = Stop, 1 = Run) is the BAS run/stop and AV 1-4 the remote setpoints and mode. MV 5 shows the control source (Local, ISN, Analog, Digital, Modem); it should read ISN for BAS control. The points list has no write-enable point.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
MV 65001 Units sets whether the BAS sees IP or SI values, independent of the chiller display; set it to match the chiller.
gotchas: The remote (commandable) setpoints read as unreliable until the BAS writes them the first time.
The SC-EQ only exposes the points that apply to the chiller it detects; if it replaces an E-Link, re-discover the device so old non-applicable points don't sit offline.
On heat pump (YS HP) units also map AV 3 (leaving hot water setpoint) and AV 4 (operating mode).
